body.name: \(\operatorname{Enum}_G^s\)
body.construction: For \(s\in\{\mathrm{pub},\mathrm{CA}\}\), use \(\mathcal K_s\) from \(\texttt{def:live-fragment-completions}\).  For \(s=\mathrm{CA}\), compute every state \(C_A\), every score \(q^{ab}(A,r,t)\), construct \(\mathcal D_G\), and prune it to \(\mathcal D_G^{\mathrm{live}}\); for \(s=\mathrm{pub}\), \(\mathcal K_s\) is the full lattice and pruning is vacuous.  Precompute \(\beta(A,r)\) for every edge of \(\mathcal K_s\).  Separately for each original row label, sort the finite viewwise exact-real rows lexicographically and intern equal rows as one integer identifier.  Set \(H_{\varnothing}^s=\{F_{\varnothing}\}\).  Process live subsets by cardinality and, for every \(F\in H_A^s\) and every edge \(A\to A\cup\{r\}\) of \(\mathcal K_s\), write the identifier of \(\beta(A,r)\) into slot \(r\) and insert the resulting integer vector into a deterministic binary trie for \(H_{A\cup\{r\}}^s\) only if absent.  Decode and emit every member of \(H_V^s\) once.  Denote this algorithm by \(\operatorname{Enum}_G^s\), with unsuperscripted conventions \(H_A=H_A^{\mathrm{pub}}\) and \(\operatorname{Enum}_G=\operatorname{Enum}_G^{\mathrm{pub}}\).
